description: Use this when someone asks how many bricks or concrete blocks a wall needs, and how much mortar or grout. Calculates the bricks or concrete blocks for a wall (length × height, or an area) less its doors and windows: the net wall area and the openings in square meters, units per square meter of one wythe with their joints, the height of one course with its joint and the courses in the wall height, the units without waste and the units to buy with waste (5 % when not given; BIA Technical Note 10 and CMHA TEK 04-02A), each rounded up. Brick counts match BIA Technical Note 10, Table 4 (modular 675 per 100 sq ft). Mortar: mortar gives the bags of premixed mortar of each size alone, with 15 % added for waste, the low end of BIA's 15 to 25 % (lb80 and lb60, QUIKRETE Mortar Mix, whose 80 lb bag lays up to 37 standard bricks or 13 blocks of 8 × 8 × 16 in; kg25, a typical 25 kg bag at the same yield per kilogram); cement gives 70 lb bags of masonry cement and sand its kilograms of sand instead (8 bags and 1 short ton of sand lay 1,000 brick-size units or 240 blocks, CMHA TEK 04-02A, Table 2, which includes waste). Other sizes scale these counts by the mortar in the joints: by volume for bricks and solid blocks, by joint length for hollow blocks on face shells. Two wythes of brick add a collar joint. Grout for hollow 6, 8, 10 and 12 in blocks follows CMHA TEK 04-02A, Table 3 (including 3 % waste), scaled by the spacing of the grouted cores: grout in liters and groutBags of 80 lb preblended grout at 0.66 cu ft each.

area.description: Area of one face of the wall in square meters, used instead of length and height.

doorHeight.description: Height of each door; 2032 when left out, in millimeters.

doorWidth.description: Width of each door; 914.4 when left out, in millimeters.

doors.description: Doors to leave out of the wall; 0 when left out.

grout.description: Spacing on center of the block cores filled with grout, in millimeters, at least 203.2 (every core); only for block6, block8, block10 and block12 at their own width; no grout when left out.

height.description: Height of the wall, in millimeters.

joint.description: Mortar joint in millimeters; the unit's own when left out, 9.525 for US units and 10 for UK units.

length.description: Length of the wall, in millimeters.

unit.description: The brick or block, width × height × length in inches for 3/8 in joints: modular 3 5/8 × 2 1/4 × 7 5/8, standard 3 5/8 × 2 1/4 × 8, queen 2 3/4 × 2 3/4 × 8, king 2 3/4 × 2 3/4 × 9 3/4, engineer (engineer modular) 3 5/8 × 2 13/16 × 7 5/8, norman 3 5/8 × 2 1/4 × 11 5/8, utility 3 5/8 × 3 5/8 × 11 5/8; uk 102.5 × 65 × 215 mm for 10 mm joints; hollow concrete blocks of 8 × 16 in on the face, nominal widths block4, block6, block8, block10, block12, each 3/8 in under nominal; ukBlock 100 × 215 × 440 mm, solid, for 10 mm joints.

unitHeight.description: Height of the unit's face, used instead of the chosen unit's, in millimeters.

unitLength.description: Length of the unit's face, used instead of the chosen unit's, in millimeters.

unitWidth.description: Width of the unit through the wall, used instead of the chosen unit's, in millimeters.

waste.description: Percent added to the units; 5 when left out.

windowHeight.description: Height of each window; 1524 when left out, in millimeters.

windowWidth.description: Width of each window; 914.4 when left out, in millimeters.

windows.description: Windows to leave out of the wall; 0 when left out.

wythes.description: Layers of brick through the wall, joined by a mortared collar joint; 1 when left out; 2 only for brick.
